records.title: Electrical Engineering (PhD)
records.degree: Doctor of Philosophy in Electrical Engineering
records.department: Ming Hsieh Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
records.description: The Doctor of Philosophy with a major in electrical engineering is awarded in strict conformity with the general requirements of the USC Graduate School. Departmental requirements consist of a concentrated program of study and research and a dissertation. Each student must first be admitted to the program and then take the screening examination, which emphasizes comprehension of fundamental material in one of the 13 specialized areas of electrical engineering.

requirement_groups.name: Screening examination
notes: Each student wishing to undertake a doctoral program must first be admitted to the program and then take the screening examination.

This examination will emphasize comprehension of fundamental material in one of the 13 specialized areas of electrical engineering. Courses offered by the department in each area provide basic background for the examination and partial preparation for the dissertation; not all listed courses are required.
Consult a separately published guide, available from the department office, for more information concerning examination content and scheduling.

requirement_groups.name: Program of study, research and dissertation
notes: Departmental requirements for this degree consist of a concentrated program of study and research and a dissertation.
Guidance on courses recommended for preparation for the dissertation, including those outside the department, can be obtained from the faculty in each technical area.
